title: Artifact spec
description: Something the learner can operate or view, embedded in a text block, a drill item or a chat message. 'type' names an Artifact subclass the app registers; it is not an enum, and an unregistered type is an import error. 'spec' is any object here: its shape is the 'spec_schema' of that type, validated by the importer (ADR-0018 section 19).
